ideas.title: FBI Obstruction of Justice: The Alex Pretti Case
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's refusal to share evidence in the Alex Pretti shooting investigation and explore the implications for transparency and accountability.
questions: Why is the FBI refusing to share evidence?
What are the implications for state and local authorities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a pattern of obstruction by the FBI and highlight the need for greater transparency and accountability in federal investigations.
